title: GLW4 gridded livestock densities (2020 vintage)
description: Gridded Livestock of the World v4, 2020 reference year. Density rasters feeding livestock numbers and value of production.

transfer.rationale: Small enough to fetch per host once the origin is pinned down.

gaps: ORIGIN NOT PINNED. 0_server_setup.R downloads the 2015 vintage from Harvard Dataverse but never fetches GLW4-2020, so on CGlabs it was staged by some other route. Until this is recorded, GLW4-2020 is effectively must-transfer and cannot be reproduced on a new host.
Empty on the laptop, which is why stage 0.4.4 reports NOT READY there.

changelog.change: Record created. Flagged the missing origin - this is the clearest reproducibility gap the catalogue has surfaced so far.
